thread:
Jamal (Hiring Manager): Hey folks — candidate for Senior Infra Eng is asking for $185k base which is above our Seattle pay tier for this role. They also need to start 2 weeks earlier than our proposed window. Can we do a market adjustment + expedite approval so we don't lose them?
Priya (People Ops): Thanks Jamal. Can you paste the complete proposed offer (base, equity, sign-on, relocation if any) and the reason we should approve an exception? Also flag if candidate has a competing offer.
Jamal (Hiring Manager): Sure — they have an offer from a startup at $190k but no RSUs. Our proposed:
```
base: $185000
RSU: 10k over 4 yrs
sign-on: $7k (one-time)
start_date: 2026-04-06 (need to move from 2026-04-20)
location: Seattle (remote-first)
reason: rare infra infra background + immediate ramp needed for major customer P0
```
Carlos (Comp & Ben): Ok. Seattle pay tier for Senior Infra is $150–165k base typically. Market adj to $185k is material. Need short justification memo for comp committee: business justification, candidate scarcity, external comp evidence (e.g., offer), and confirmation that total comp stays within approved band+budget after adjustments. Please add the competing offer screenshot if you have it.
Jamal (Hiring Manager): Uploaded screenshot to the candidate folder and added the hiring rationale doc. Quick note: candidate has on-call SRE sysperf experience we can't easily replace — high ramp cost if we pass.
Priya (People Ops): Routing to @comp-committee and @finance. Tagging @legal for standard offer language review. people-ops-bot: created approval request PR-5883 and assigned to comp-committee. ETA 24–48h for committee decision; if committee approves we can sign and honor the earlier start.
Elena (Finance): Finance note — we have budget headroom this quarter but need to confirm whether sign-on can be charged to hiring manager discretionary vs. central hiring pool. Jamal — please confirm which cost center.
Jamal (Hiring Manager): Charge to ENG-PLAT-03 (my hiring bucket).
Carlos (Comp & Ben): Quick process note: include the following in the memo so committee can fast-track: 1) comp table (current band vs requested), 2) external offer evidence, 3) headcount/impact statement, 4) start date justification. If you post that in the PR I'll push it up.
Priya (People Ops): I've added the comp-committee reviewers and set priority to high. people-ops-bot: notified legal and finance.
Legal Bot: Reviewed standard clause for earlier start and sign-on clawback. No red flags.
Carlos (Comp & Ben): With the documentation provided, I'm marking this as "recommend approve" pending final committee sign-off.
Priya (People Ops): Noted. @comp-committee — please review PR-5883 (link in thread) when you have a moment; candidate needs decision within 24h to prevent them accepting the external offer. If approved, we'll issue the offer and update start date to 2026-04-06. :clock1:
Jamal (Hiring Manager): Appreciate it — I'll hold candidate requests and tell them we're expediting. :pray:
people-ops-bot: comp-committee pinged; reminder set for 4 hours.
Priya (People Ops): Update — comp-committee approved via thumbs-up vote. Final approval recorded in PR-5883. Elena, please confirm funding charge path one last time so we can send the official offer.
Elena (Finance): Confirmed charge to ENG-PLAT-03 and sign-on approved from hiring manager pool. You can proceed.
Priya (People Ops): Great — Jamal, offer letter template updated with the approved figures and new start date. Please do final candidate touchpoint and have them sign by EOD. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
